ينعدم (form VII)
# يَنْعَدِمُ (yanʕadimu) /jan.ʕa.di.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# يَنْعَدِمَ (yanʕadima) /jan.ʕa.di.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# يَنْعَدِمْ (yanʕadim) /jan.ʕa.dim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
